summary.headline: Vatican Codex Astrological and Medical Texts
summary.text: Catalog entries for a Vatican codex covering planetary day-significations, zodiacal weather omens, Ptolemy’s Apotelesmatika, brontologia, lunar calculations, and medical excerpts from Galen on diagnoses, drugs, thirst, and astringents.
